sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Foundational Principle 1**: The NAPCC follows the principle of **Common But Differentiated Responsibilities (CBDR)**, emphasizing India's right to development while pursuing low-carbon growth.
• **Foundational Principle 2**: It is implemented through **Eight National Missions** that focus on both mitigation (reducing emissions) and adaptation (building resilience).
• **Foundational Principle 3**: The plan is overseen by the **Prime Minister's Council on Climate Change**, ensuring high-level inter-ministerial coordination.
• **Key Metric / Factor**: The plan aims to maintain a balance between economic growth and environmental sustainability, aligning with India's **Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)**.

items.definition: A market-based mechanism under the National Mission for Enhanced Energy Efficiency to reduce specific energy consumption in energy-intensive industries.

items.term: SAPCC (State Action Plan on Climate Change)
items.definition: The decentralized implementation arm of NAPCC, where states formulate plans aligned with national goals based on their specific regional vulnerabilities.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Key Application 1**: Solar Mission led to the creation of the International Solar Alliance (ISA).
• **Key Application 2**: Green India Mission focuses on increasing forest cover and ecosystem services.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Key Challenges**: Financial constraints, lack of inter-departmental synergy, and data gaps in climate monitoring.
• **Solutions**: Climate budgeting, private sector participation, and leveraging climate finance (Green Climate Fund).

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'S-E-S-W-H-A-G-S'
• **Decoded Meaning**: Solar, Enhanced Energy Efficiency, Sustainable Habitat, Water, Himalayan Ecosystem, Agriculture, Green India, Strategic Knowledge.

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses the 'National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture' with 'National Mission for Sustainable Habitat'. Remember: Habitat = Urban/Buildings; Agriculture = Soil/Crops.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Climate-Resilient Development' when discussing NAPCC in the context of India's NDCs and the Paris Agreement.

keyTakeaways: NAPCC is the umbrella framework for India's climate policy.
It consists of 8 missions covering both mitigation and adaptation.
Implementation is decentralized through State Action Plans (SAPCC).
